On an unusual occasion, Li Hua prepares to show Chen Ming a project.

[Question]
What kind of project does Li Hua prepare to show Chen Ming?

B. A large-scale automation factory project, which achieves efficient production and environmental protection through advanced automation technology and energy-saving measures
